cases.name: Danielle Baker
cases.about:
Her cousin, Linda Donaldson, remembered Baker as generous and "always smiling." Danielle was a day student in Jackson County's Teen Parenting program at a the Family Service Center in Marianna. Her three oldest children spent part of every day in prekindergarten at the center.

Baker hoped to go to school to become a nurse, said her sister, Shemeka Marlowe.
cases.narrative: On 3/17/2005, their bodies were found by an apartment maintenance worker who was told by a neighbor they heard knocking on the walls. Her 2-year-old daughter who survived had been left with their bodies. He had shot Danielle and suffocated her three sons.
